origin: Exact prompt wording reconstructed from this agent's original tool calls; corresponding raw image bytes recovered from retained functions.store.
reference_order: Original actual native final-fit-candidate/male-{pose}.png, authority for registration/pose/body
common_prompt:
LOCAL ARTISTIC IMAGE EDIT. Image 1 is the authoritative actual game avatar, a single full-body bald male on transparency, canvas 1100x1672. Image 2 is an approved clothing concept board and is ONLY a fabric/design guide. Return exactly ONE avatar in image 1's exact pose, registration and composition, same full canvas, transparent background. DO NOT make a concept board.
Edit ONLY the TWO PAJAMA SLEEVES. Artistically repaint these sleeves from shoulder cap to cuff; do not procedurally twist/stretch texture. Match the approved gray-blue woven cotton pajama fabric, fine narrow ivory vertical pinstripes, muted charcoal piping at cuffs and seams, calm painterly realistic game rendering and correct soft cloth volume. Keep stripe width and regular scale close to image 1's unchanged torso; stripes curve naturally with folds and perspective without huge fanning, V-shaped shoulder epaulettes, blocky pasted panels, sharp jagged elbows or repeated distortions. Front portions of sleeves must visibly lie ABOVE torso at arm/torso overlap.
STRICTLY PRESERVE UNCHANGED: the original face and bald head, anatomy/body proportions, skin tone, neck, exposed skin/hands/fingers, exact pose, torso front/collar/lapels, straight center placket and ALL buttons, chest pocket, shirt hem, pants and slippers, lighting on other regions, all weapon geometry and grips. Do not redraw or reposition the character or weapon, do not redesign the outfit, do not alter the shirt torso. Treat unchanged pixels as locked. No writing, annotation, border, extra object, extra person or background. Preserve original transparency.

pose_prompt_suffix.idle: The man is standing still with both arms relaxed at his sides. Redraw BOTH sleeves following the existing original relaxed arms and exact wrist endpoints. Use natural vertical weight, softly rounded elbows, gentle cloth folds; the stripes run smoothly down the cylindrical sleeve, with the same narrow pitch as the unchanged torso. Replace jagged pasted wedges/strip triangles at shoulder and elbow with hand-painted coherent cloth.
pose_prompt_suffix.melee: The man stands in the original exact knife pose: screen-left hand grips the original downward-pointing knife near the thigh, screen-right hand relaxed. Redraw BOTH sleeves following those exact original arm contours and wrist positions. The knife and its gripping hand remain absolutely unchanged and fully in front of cloth. Use rounded shoulder caps, gently weighted sleeves and subtle anatomical elbow folds, consistent narrow pinstripe pitch, no stretched diagonal panels.
pose_prompt_suffix.rifle: The man holds the ORIGINAL AK rifle across his chest at the EXACT existing pose and two hand grip locations. Redraw BOTH sleeves anatomically around these existing bent arms. The screen-left forearm extends horizontally toward the receiver; create a softly rounded bent elbow and coherent cylindrical cloth with fine pinstripes bending naturally around the sleeve, no triangular fan or square donor patch. The screen-right support arm bends to its existing hand. THE ORIGINAL ENTIRE RIFLE MUST REMAIN ABOVE ALL CLOTHING, including stock, receiver, trigger guard, magazine, barrel; hands and fingers remain original and in front at the same grips. Sleeves end precisely behind exposed original wrists, never cover hands or weapon.

assembly: common_prompt + newline + POSE-SPECIFIC EDIT: + newline + pose_prompt_suffix[pose]
